capabilities.description: Syncs your Letterboxd watchlist with your Silo watchlist in both directions. Movies only; TV series in Silo are left alone.

config_schema.title: Sign in to Letterboxd
config_schema.description: Letterboxd has no API keys. Enter your username or email here, and your Letterboxd password in the box labeled API key below. Silo stores both encrypted; the password is only used to sign in again when the session expires. Only the watchlist syncs; the other options on this page have no effect for Letterboxd.

fields.label: Username or email
fields.description: The name you sign in to letterboxd.com with.
